name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
summary: On the snowy road from Coldridge Pass to Kharanos, Hegnar Rumbleshot supplies hunters and mountaineers with firearms and ammunition.

sections.title: A Gunsmith on the Road
sections.body: Between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos, Hegnar's small camp serves dwarven marksmen, travelers, and the local militia. Mountain folk use its popular range to practice against Dun Morogh's wild beasts. The steady stream of shooters keeps Hegnar reliant on fresh ammunition from Loslor Rudge, a dwarf engineer.

faq.answer: Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a gunsmith's camp and outdoor shooting range on the road between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos.

faq.q: Where does Hegnar get his ammunition?
faq.answer: Hegnar gets ammunition from Loslor Rudge, a dwarf engineer elsewhere in Dun Morogh who supplies the range.

faq.q: What does Hegnar do for the local dwarves?
faq.answer: Hegnar supplies local hunters and militia members with firearms and shot. He also offers a practice range for marksmen traveling through Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a hunter traveling from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh's snowy peaks, you can get shot, ammunition pouches, and spare firearms from Hegnar.
As a dwarf, you can practice your marksmanship alongside travelers at Hegnar's roadside range.
